_comment: What a hosted tenant may change of its own digest, and the caps it is held to (docs/decisions/0040-a-hosted-tenant-edits-its-settings-on-the-hosted-worker.md). Read by the hosted Worker's settings routes (workers/app/src/hosted_shared_settings.js), its poll (tenant_buffer.js), and by the tenant's run container (src/cyris/adapters/hosted.py), which pins `provider`, `model`, `embedding_provider`, `embedding_model` and `blank_settings` and clamps the article cap whatever the tenant's database holds. `embedding_provider` and `embedding_model` are the embedder a tenant's vote similarity runs on, the operator's Workers AI account, whose token is the Worker's CLOUDFLARE_EMBEDDING_API_TOKEN (scripts/hosted.sh secrets) and whose spend is metered as embedding_usd (docs/decisions/0049-a-hosted-tenants-embedding-runs-on-the-operators-workers-ai.md); an empty model is the provider's default (src/cyris/provider_defaults.json), as the seed's starting value is. Constants: an operator-changeable cap is a later card. `writable_settings` is every settings key a tenant writes on /t/<tenant>/settings; the schedule is written through the registry, never as a settings row. `operator_keys` are what the operator alone sets, outside `settings`. `source_url` and `poll` are the rules a tenant's feed URL is held to when it is saved and at every hop of a poll; `poll.max_redirects` and `poll.max_feed_bytes` equal feed_check.py's MAX_REDIRECTS and MAX_BYTES (tests/test_hosted_settings_policy.py).

shared_page._comment: The settings page every edition shares, which the hosted Worker serves at /t/<tenant>/settings (workers/app/src/hosted_shared_settings.js, docs/decisions/0043-one-settings-page-an-edition-locks-a-key.md). It opens the keys a tenant writes, `writable_settings` and the schedule's hours and zone, and locks every other for `operator_reason`, one of `LockReason` in src/cyris/entrypoints/triage_server.py. A second hour past the tenant's `max_digest_times` is the page's to lock, for `plan-limit`, from the answer's `limits`.
